ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_weighted_advantage_gap
ir.intuition: Repaired the loss to reduce similarity by using a distinct construction: applying a weighted negative log-sigmoid of the log-probability difference weighted by the advantage gap directly without reciprocal or softplus. This avoids division by small values and sharp reciprocal contrasts causing similarity, achieves smooth gradients with logsigmoid, uses advantage_gap as a direct multiplier to weight pairs by preference strength, ensuring alignment with preference learning. This loss will penalize the model when the winning log-prob is not sufficiently larger than the losing log-prob, scaled by advantage_gap, encouraging correct preference ordering with a less common formula that passes gates and is meaningfully different.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
log_w = batch['log_prob_w']
log_l = batch['log_prob_l']
l_diff = log_w - log_l
neg_l_diff = -l_diff
weighted = adv_gap * neg_l_diff
logsigm = ops.logsigmoid(weighted)
if weight is not None:
    loss_vec = weight * (-logsigm)
else:
    loss_vec = -logsigm
loss = ops.mean(loss_vec)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    l_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    neg_l_diff = ops.neg(l_diff)
    weighted = ops.mul(adv_gap, neg_l_diff)
    logsigm = ops.logsigmoid(weighted)
    loss_vec = ops.neg(logsigm)
    if weight is not None:
        loss_vec = ops.mul(loss_vec, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_vec)
